@'
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import numpy as np
from image_compare import NpyImage, NpyImageCropper

with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    for shape in ((6, 8), (5, 7), (6, 8, 3), (1, 1)):
        original = np.arange(np.prod(shape)).reshape(shape)
        path = Path(directory) / 'image.npy'
        np.save(path, original)
        cropped = NpyImageCropper(path)
        expected = original[:shape[0] // 2, :shape[1] // 2]
        assert isinstance(cropped, NpyImage)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(cropped.data, expected)
        assert cropped.shape == expected.shape
        assert cropped.name == path.name
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(np.load(path), original)
        print(f'PASS: {shape} -> {cropped.shape}')
'@ | & '<workspace>/.venv/Scripts/python.exe' -B -
tool_input.explanation: Check crop dimensions and pixel values for even, odd, color, and single-pixel images, and verify source files remain unchanged.
